title: cert.rs pathLen implementation correctly traces RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 semantics
description: cert.rs validate_chain(): chain_depth is counted AFTER checking the parent's pathLen, correctly implementing the RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 rule that pathLen constrains the number of intermediate CAs below the issuer — not including the issuer itself. A contributor might simplify this to >= instead of > or move the increment, which would be wrong. Keep as-is.
